news.headline: General Code and American Legal Publishing Unite as ICC Code Solutions

paragraphs: General Code helps local governments publish and maintain their municipal codes and put that content where staff and residents can reach it. The site frames the aim as keeping a community's code consistent, organized and easy to get at. Digital access to that code content is offered around the clock.

Beyond the code itself, the company digitizes a jurisdiction's documents and records so they can be searched. Zoning work pairs the code content with maps. Building code services fold local amendments into the International Codes. A research subscription opens access to nearly four thousand municipal codes. An API lets a jurisdiction connect its code content to other municipal applications.

The customers described are municipal, county, state and tribal jurisdictions, along with municipal leagues and associations. The company states that General Code and American Legal Publishing are being brought together under one unified brand. The two are presented as bringing combined codification experience to that brand. The resulting brand is described as part of a wider ICC initiative.
